scope: Source/materiality qualification before any candidate or runtime work
defaultRequirement: Independently observe dotnet/aspnetcore main through read-only gh, then freeze the exact commit; reserved checkout is navigation-only, never Default.
sourceAcceptance: Preserve complete pinned relevant source bytes and exact repository/commit/path/blob bindings for both roles on this host.
Read applicable Components and cross-cutting instructions and guidance.
Trace actual browser-to-native-to-managed message producer where authoritative pinned source is accessible, explicitly identifying unresolved external boundaries.
Trace WebViewManager.MessageReceived and actual Photino dispatcher/synchronization-context ownership, UI forwarding, reentrancy, ordering, cancellation, fault and lifetime semantics.
Inspect source history and bound normal sample cardinality from the actual sample, without generating a workload.
Treat explicit required off-browser-UI dispatch as semantics, not automatically removable overhead.
If no justified material semantics-preserving candidate exists, return source-only no-material-candidate/required-work disposition, not measured no-gain.
Seal every retained payload file by hash and report actual native process roots, streams, known children, failures and remaining limits.
conditionalImplementationGate: Only after source qualification yields a surgical semantics-preserving material candidate; private ap-F212-o233 and ap-F212-d233 only, existing faithful tests, fresh registration/lease/HOLD guards and exact graph activation before every native start.
excluded: No manufactured message bursts, bridge, queue, browser simulation, injected callback, repetition or isolated task-scheduling experiment.
No timings, warmups, allocation counters, profilers, performance eligibility/authorization or comparisons.
No shared checkout/index/HEAD edits, machine changes, SDK/package installs, remote/Azure execution, subagents or GitHub writes.
No public API, cache, threading, ordering, queueing, cancellation, fault, lifetime, manifest or default changes.
No product implementation or tests solely to satisfy an implementation workflow when source-only qualification rejects the candidate.
validationBoundary: Source-only unless a separately justified existing producer-faithful correctness path is admitted; source provenance is not loaded-runtime proof.
